title: NVIDIA and Meta expand model–infrastructure collaboration
dek: A deeper Muse partnership couples model optimization with NVIDIA accelerators, networking and a $3B strategic investment.
evidence: NVIDIA/Meta joint announcement; no independently demonstrated inference TCO results
takeaway: Distinguish announced hardware/model integration from reproducible latency and total-cost improvements.

sections.title: Agreement

bullets.detail: The companies plan to jointly optimize Muse-family training and inference, with Meta expanding Vera Rubin, Vera CPU, Spectrum-X and BlueField-4 deployments.
NVIDIA committed to invest $3B in Meta's equity offering; model and infrastructure plans are distinct from a measured production benchmark.

paragraphs: Technical layer: The companies plan to jointly optimize Muse-family training and inference, with Meta expanding Vera Rubin, Vera CPU, Spectrum-X and BlueField-4 deployments.
Commercial layer: NVIDIA committed to invest $3B in Meta's equity offering; model and infrastructure plans are distinct from a measured production benchmark.

sections.title: Engineering test

bullets.detail: The announcement also mentions potential work on OpenShell and Sentry to monitor or isolate agents; possible collaborations should not be treated as delivered features.
Compare throughput per watt, end-to-end tool latency, networking bottlenecks and workload-level dollars per successful task on representative workloads.
